subject: science
concept: Recognizing what living things need to survive (food, water, air, space)
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student cares for a real or virtual plant/pet scenario, providing what it needs to survive
exercise.pictorial: Student matches living things to the things they need to survive
exercise.abstract: Student lists what a given living thing needs to stay alive

misconception_flags: lists a want (like a toy) rather than a genuine survival need

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
